records.statement: Pass identity: def FlattenOps : Pass<"hfusion-flatten-ops", "func::FuncOp"> with constructor mlir::hfusion::createFlattenOpsPass(), summary 'Flatten linalg and hfusion ops.', dependentDialects linalg, hfusion, memref, tensor — the pass operates on one function at a time.

Six pass options with defaults: flatten-mode (hfusion::FlattenMode, default Greedy; 'greedy' = 'Outlined function with greedy elemwise flatten', 'tidy' = 'Outlined function with analysis'; option description 'Flatten mode, tidy mode will do an analysis on the entire function'); skip-host (bool, default false, 'Whether to skip the host function or not'); multi-dynamic-shape (bool, default true, 'Whether to collapse multiple dynamic shape or not'); register-based (bool, default false, 'Whether to use register-based flatten for RegBase targets'); use-preorder-walk-traversal (bool, default true, 'Use operation walk<PreOrder> traversal instead of BFS in dimension analyzer'); skip-scope (bool, default true, 'Whether to skip the current pass when scope exists').
Greedy mode body: builds a RewritePatternSet via populateFlattenOpsPattern(patterns) and runs applyPatternsGreedily(funcOp, ...); if that fails the pass calls signalPassFailure and returns.

FlattenElemwiseOpPattern<LinalgOpTy>::matchAndRewrite: returns failure when linalgOp.getNumLoops() <= 1 (already flat); otherwise builds ReassociationIndices as the identity over all loop dims (std::iota); flattens only when isElementwise(linalgOp) && !llvm::isa<linalg::BroadcastOp>(linalgOp) — anything else is rewriter.notifyMatchFailure(linalgOp, "only elementwise flattening is supported"); on success collapseOpIterationDims(linalgOp, reassociation, rewriter) and rewriter.replaceOp(linalgOp, maybeFlattened->results). In-code TODO at lines 62-63: 'NEXT : rewrite isElementwise by judging there is at least one computational elementwise op(e.g add).'

populateFlattenOpsPattern registers FlattenElemwiseOpPattern for every op included from mlir/Dialect/Linalg/IR/LinalgStructuredOps.cpp.inc and bishengir/Dialect/HFusion/IR/HFusionStructuredOps.cpp.inc, plus one explicit extra registration for linalg::GenericOp.

Tidy mode body: returns early when hacc::utils::isHost(funcOp) && this->skipHost; returns early when this->registerBased && util::hasUnpropagateableCase(funcOp, this->skipScope) (preceded by the comment '// Experimental Flatten, can remove this if'); otherwise builds mlir::detail::DimensionAnalyzerOptions{registerBased = this->registerBased, usePreOrderWalkTraversal = this->usePreOrderWalkTraversal}, constructs hfusion::detail::Flattener flattener(funcOp, options) and calls flattener.flatten(multiDynamicShape); a failed flatten calls signalPassFailure.
util::hasUnpropagateableCase(op, skipScope) returns hasCustomOp(op) || hasComplexControlFlow(op), plus hasScope(op) when skipScope is true (declared in HFusion/Utils/Utils.h:395).

Core-type gate: runOnOperation first queries mlir::hivm::queryFuncCoreType(funcOp); if the optional has a value and it equals TFuncCoreType::AIC the pass returns immediately, and likewise for TFuncCoreType::AIV — only unlabeled functions and the MIX / AIC_OR_AIV labels reach the flattening logic. The enum HIVM_TFuncCoreTypeEnum defines cases AIC, AIV, MIX, AIC_OR_AIV.

The tidy engine class Flattener (hfusion::detail) extends DimensionAnalyzer (bishengir/Dialect/HFusion/Analysis/DimensionAnalyzer.h) and exposes one entry point flatten(bool multiDynamicShape). Its private surface shows the rewrite machinery: mutable bookkeeping (newlyAddedCollapse, valueReplacement, markToDelete, flattenerWorkList); boundary-breaking helpers (breakSubByteI1CollapseBoundaries — 'Breaks collapse boundaries for i1 values whose innermost dimension size is not a multiple of 8', breakDynamicShapes, markBroken, propagateBroken); and per-op adjust* methods covering arange/flip/sort, tensor extract/pad, gather/gather_load/scatter_store, subview and extract/insert_slice with stride/offset recomputation, concat/insert, interleave/deinterleave, broadcast, transpose, scf if/for/yield, reduce-like and cumulative ops, memref load/store, to_tensor/to_memref, cast, embedding_gather, indirect_load — plus collapsing of block arguments (collapseTensorArg/collapseMemrefArg) and return/tail-value expansion (adjustReturnOp, expandForTail).

Placement A — buildHFusionRegBasePipeline (HFusionRegbasePipelines.cpp:567-600): inside `if (options.enableFlatten)` (:571) the pipeline nests, in order, tensor::createPropagateReshapePass with forRegbased=true (:572-575), tensor::createFoldTensorEmptyPass (:576), tensor::createCanonicalizeTensorReshapePass (:577-578), canonicalizationPipeline (:579), then createFlattenOpsPass with {flattenMode=Tidy, skipHost=options.enableMultiKernel, multiDynamicShape=false, registerBased=true} (:581-586; skipScope not overridden here, so the Passes.td default true applies per EV-002), then canonicalizationPipeline with the AfterAutoSchedule phase (:587). NormalizeOps, InlineBrc and hfusionAutoVectorizePipeline follow (:590-599).

Placement B — hfusionAutoVectorizePipeline: inside `if (enableSIMDVFFusion(hfusionOptions))` (:402; enableSIMDVFFusion is defined at :602-604 as exactly `options.enableTritonKernelCompile`), after pm.addPass(analysis::createVFFusionPass(vfFusionOptions)) (:414), the pass is added when `runRegBasePasses && hfusionOptions.enableFlatten` (:415-423) with {flattenMode=Tidy, skipHost=hfusionOptions.enableMultiKernel, multiDynamicShape=false, registerBased=true, skipScope=hfusionOptions.skipScope}; canonicalizationPipeline follows (:424). Later in the same function, createHFusionAutoVectorizeV2Pass runs gated by enableAutoVectorizeV2 (:434-450) followed by createOutlineVectorFunctionPass (:451) — so flatten sits between VFFusion and AutoVectorizeV2. A third, same-shaped site exists in buildHFusionPipelines' Triton-kernel-compile branch (:528-546, after PropagateReshape/FoldTensorEmpty/CanonicalizeTensorReshape, also registerBased=true).

Non-Triton auto-schedule path (buildHFusionPipelines :508-519: preFlattenPass + flattenAndFold before inferAndOutlineOp and hfusionAutoSchedulePipeline): preFlattenPass (:207-229) ends with PropagateReshape + SimplifyOps + canonicalization; flattenAndFold (:241-263) runs FoldTensorEmpty, then createFlattenOpsPass with {flattenMode=Tidy, skipHost=options.enableMultiKernel, multiDynamicShape=false} — registerBased NOT set, so the default false applies — then CanonicalizeTensorReshape and two canonicalizationPipeline calls tagged with the AfterFlattenBeforeAutoSchedule phase (enum at :71, used by the canonicalization gates at :96).

Greedy fixture (RUN: bishengir-opt -hfusion-flatten-ops="flatten-mode=greedy" -split-input-file): linalg.fill, linalg.map{arith.addf}, linalg.generic with two parallel dims, and hfusion.elemwise_unary over memref<32x7xf32> are all expected as the same op on memref<224xf32> behind memref.collapse_shape [0,1]; the tensor form (@fill_tensor, :15-24) additionally restores the original shape with tensor.expand_shape before return; a tensor<32x1xf32> case collapses to <32xf32> (:78-99); a 64x64 matmul_mx kernel case appears whose only CHECKs pin the memref.reinterpret_cast lines (:111, :120).

Tidy fixture (pass-pipeline builtin.module(func.func(hfusion-flatten-ops{flatten-mode=tidy}), cse, canonicalize-ext)): @broadcast_mul_reduce (broadcast→mul→reduce) keeps linalg.broadcast with 'CHECK-NOT: tensor.collapse_shape' — the whole-function analysis declines to flatten this shape (:7-22); @broadcast_mul_onebc fully collapses 1024x1024→1048576 with reassociation [[0,1]] and partially collapses 1024x1024x1024→1048576x1024 with [[0,1],[2]] (:26-42); @complex_ops_1 collapses 5x6x6→5x36 and expands back to 5x6x6 at the results — partial groups, not full flattening (:46-57).

Register-based tidy fixture (RUN: --hfusion-flatten-ops="flatten-mode=tidy register-based=true"): @memref_load_store's memref.load/memref.store ops on memref<1x111xi8> buffers are expected on memref<111xi8> after flattening (:6-32); @test_arange_0's hfusion.arange with outs tensor<1x150xi32> is expected as outs tensor<150xi32> (:36-60); the fixture functions carry hacc.entry / hacc.function_kind<DEVICE> / mix_mode="aiv" attributes and are still processed (no hivm.func_core_type AIC/AIV label present).

History of bishengir/lib/Dialect/HFusion/Transforms/FlattenOps.cpp (git log --follow): the file entered master with the HFusion dialect commit 2d1ae329b (2025-10-09, '[AscendNPU IR] Add HFusion') and was later synced wholesale from the regbase branch by d6108a72f (2026-07-17, '[AscendNPU-IR] sync FlattenOps from regbase'); the FlattenOps test directory's recent history includes 9860b2978 ('Allow the flattener to trace and pack multi-dimensional scalar data streams into 1D registers.') and f64f1dbac ('!2448 merge fix/flatten_arangeop into master').

Greedy vs tidy semantics: greedy is a local, per-op rewriter — every registered structured op that is elementwise, non-broadcast, and has more than one loop dim is fully collapsed with the identity reassociation; tidy is a whole-function analyzer — it computes collapse groups (possibly partial, e.g. [[0,1],[2]]), declines shapes whose flattening would harm the surrounding computation (the broadcast-into-reduce case), and adjusts a much wider op surface including memref accesses and indexing ops. Inferred from EV-002's option wording ('greedy elemwise flatten' vs 'analysis on the entire function') plus EV-004, EV-013, EV-014.

Why the AIC/AIV skip exists: the gate means the pass reshapes IR only while functions carry no cube/vector core label (or carry MIX / AIC_OR_AIV); once a function is already labeled AIC or AIV the pass silently leaves it alone, plausibly because a labeled function is already specialized for one core and reshaping it again is unwanted. No comment states the rationale — inferred from EV-008's bare returns and from the fixtures, whose processed functions carry no func_core_type label (EV-015).

What vectorization gets from flatten: with elementwise chains in 1-D form, the auto-vectorizer and VF formation treat whole iteration domains as uniform vector work without per-dimension case analysis, which is why the pass sits directly after VFFusion and before AutoVectorizeV2 in the SIMD branch. This is structural inference from the branch ordering (EV-011), the mode descriptions in Passes.td (EV-002), and the flattened fixtures (EV-013, EV-015); no comment in the pipeline file states this motivation.

The tidy engine's implementation (bishengir/lib/Dialect/HFusion/Transforms/Flattener/Flattener.cpp, 272 lines) and the DimensionAnalyzer it extends were not read in this analysis: the exact collapse-group legality rules, the full dynamic-shape handling beyond the multiDynamicShape flag, and the complete set of decline conditions are unknown at HEAD. Only the class surface (EV-009) and the observed outputs pinned by the fixtures (EV-014, EV-015) are evidence.
